scope: Return-page verification must not wait for the mail provider
problem: The browser request has a 20-second timeout, but after atomic payment fulfillment the handler awaited mail claiming, content reads, payload freeze, provider request and finalization. Slow mail could delay an already-unlocked result.
change: Return confirmed capability/result immediately after fulfill_checkout commits access and durable email job. Only the private queue worker performs delivery, matching the existing signed-webhook path.

validation.regression_before: Failed: handler called claim_result_emails after fulfill_checkout
validation.regression_after: Passed: handler responds with the protected result, no-store header, exactly the fulfillment RPC and no mail claim; malformed checkout IDs never reach Stripe

invariants: Payment facts remain canonical Stripe server data
Access and email enqueue remain one database transaction
Email retries still use frozen payload and provider idempotency
Mail failure cannot delay or roll back paid access
No wording, price, scoring or stored results changed
rollout: Private worker/scheduler is mandatory before production release; not configured or enabled by this change.
